desktop_fallback_hints.notes: The extracted desktop app builds the fallback-model picker from `deviceSupportPkg.deviceIdList`, grouped by `dspId` into `deviceModelsByDspIds`, then serves that through the `get-dspid-fallback-models` IPC handler. So the fallback picker is not an independent runtime-identity catalog and does not resolve the USB-only alias labels that are absent from `deviceIdList`.

dirac_binary_hints.notes: The packaged Dirac helper binary includes `Harmony DSP 8x12`, `Failed to get dsp id, assume it is 113`, `dsp id is 115`, and `PADSP-8x12-DL`. That is stronger official evidence than the top-level XML for Harmony / 8x12-DL family hints, but it still does not expose an exact `hw_id` mapping.
